passages.note: Concurrence vote on Haney's own bill; the vote page names the tally and the author but no provision.
passages.actor_quote: Motion AB 1775 Haney Concurrence in Senate Amendments
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 63 Noes Count 5 NVR Count 11

passages.provision_quote: (B) (i) Preparation or sale of noncannabis food or beverage products in compliance with all applicable provisions of the California Retail Food Code (Chapter 1 (commencing with Section 113700) of Part 7 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code) by a retailer or microbusiness licensed under this division in the area where the consumption of cannabis is allowed.
passages.note: Digest names Haney as author; the amended section only lets localities allow ancillary food/beverage sales and performances at already-licensed consumption lounges.

rows.reasoning: AB 1775 (2023-2024), authored by Haney, only authorizes a local jurisdiction to let an already-licensed cannabis retailer sell noncannabis food or beverages and host ticketed live performances in its existing consumption area; it does not touch whether cannabis itself should be 'fully illegal', limited to medical use, decriminalized for possession, or legalized as a licensed commercial market versus an ordinary product with minimal restrictions. Neither passage speaks to the dimension the rungs order, so no chair is established.
